### Find Peace With God
Author: Billy Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/devotions/find-peace-with-god
Passage: Psalm 29:11
Points:
- Finding true peace requires ending our own resistance and surrendering to God.
- Walking in humble service motivated by faith and love leads to peace with God.
- Experiencing peace with God enables believers to enjoy His ongoing, supernatural peace.
- Divine peace is a tangible daily reality rather than an abstract theological idea.
- Christ Himself provides a steadfast peace that does not depend on outward circumstances.

### Wisdom from the Psalms 3/19
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-3-or-19-552214.html
Passage: Psalm 29:4
Points:
- The thundering power displayed in nature reminds believers of God's majestic voice.
- Remembering the Lord's supreme might brings comforting assurance rather than fear.
- Because God possesses absolute authority and power, nothing can defeat Him.
- Recognizing the Creator's grandeur leads believers to trust His loving protection.
